scanNote:
WORKBOOK 10-UNITNING TO'RTINChI (oxirgi) BETI (45-bet). Yuqorida o'ngda 'Stick to the Rules!' va to'q sariq '10'.

CHAP USTUN:
(11-mashq davomi) 4 (xarid qilayotgan ayol; bank kassiri 'TELLER'): go shopping / go to the bank. A: B: A: 5 (kapoti ochiq mashina va mexanik; veterinar va mushuk): take my car to the mechanic / take my cat to the vet. A: B: A:
• 'Reading'.
12) 'Read the leaflet, then mark the statements as T (true) or F (false).' VARAQA 'Rules of Diving' (suv ostidagi g'avvoslar surati): • Never dive alone. If you dive alone, you won't have anyone to help you if there's a problem. • Always mark the place where you are diving with a flag. If you don't, a boat might hit you. • Never panic if you see a shark. If you do panic, it could attack you. • Make sure you check your equipment carefully before you dive. If you don't, you might have serious problems while you are underwater. • Never dive when you are ill or tired. If you do, you might not have enough energy to save yourself in a dangerous situation. • Make sure you check your air supply regularly while you are underwater. If you don't, you could run out of air and drown.
  T/F: 1 You should dive alone. 2 It's a good idea to mark the place where you are diving with a flag. 3 If you see a shark, you should panic.

O'NG USTUN (12 davomi): 4 If you don't check your equipment, you won't have any problems while you're underwater. 5 You shouldn't dive if you've got a cold. 6 You will be okay if you run out of air.
• 'Writing (a safety leaflet)'.
13) 'Look at the prompts and make sentences with always or never, as in the example.' 'SAFE SAILING' (yelkanli qayiqlar surati). PUFAKLAR: 1 check/weather forecast before going sailing - you/sail into/storm. 2 tell somebody where you are going - you/get into trouble/nobody/know where you/be. 3 take warm, waterproof clothing with you - it/get cold/you/freeze to death. 4 go sailing without/lifejacket - you/fall into/water/drown. 5 sail close to rocks - you/destroy/boat/hurt yourself/drown. 6 sail near swimmers - you/hurt somebody. Qiya namuna: 'Always check the weather forecast before going sailing. If you don't, you could sail into a storm.'
14) 'Use ideas from Ex. 13, as well as your own, to write a leaflet on safe sailing (100 - 130 words). Use the leaflet in Ex. 12 as a model.'

exercises.explanationUz:
XAVFSIZLIK VARAQASI - G'AVVOSLIK
  (coursebook 74-bet yozish
  qoidasi).

QOLIP (har band):
  Never/Always/Make sure you +
  QOIDA. If you (don't) ..., you
  might/could/won't + NATIJA.

  ⚠ Buyruq mayli + 1-tur shart
  gap + might/could.


⚠ 'TO DIVE':

  = sho'ng'imoq, g'avvoslik qilmoq.
  'diving' = g'avvoslik.


⚠ 'TO PANIC':

  = vahimaga tushmoq. 'If you DO
  panic' - 'do' urg'u uchun.


⚠ 'EQUIPMENT':

  = jihozlar (sanalmas).


⚠ 'AIR SUPPLY':

  = havo zaxirasi (ballon).


⚠ 'TO RUN OUT OF':

  = tugab qolmoq (havo, pul).


⚠ 'TO DROWN':

  = cho'kib o'lmoq.

points.en: Never dive alone. If you dive alone, you won't have anyone to help you if there's a problem.
points.uz: Hech qachon yolg'iz sho'ng'imang. Agar yolg'iz sho'ng'isangiz, muammo bo'lganda sizga yordam beradigan hech kim bo'lmaydi.

points.en: Always mark the place where you are diving with a flag. If you don't, a boat might hit you.
points.uz: Sho'ng'iyotgan joyingizni har doim bayroq bilan belgilang. Agar belgilamasangiz, qayiq sizni urib ketishi mumkin.

points.en: Never panic if you see a shark. If you do panic, it could attack you.
points.uz: Akulani ko'rsangiz hech qachon vahimaga tushmang. Agar vahimaga tushsangiz, u sizga hujum qilishi mumkin.

points.en: Make sure you check your equipment carefully before you dive. If you don't, you might have serious problems while you are underwater.
points.uz: Sho'ng'ishdan oldin jihozlaringizni albatta diqqat bilan tekshiring. Agar tekshirmasangiz, suv ostida jiddiy muammolarga duch kelishingiz mumkin.

points.en: Never dive when you are ill or tired. If you do, you might not have enough energy to save yourself in a dangerous situation.
points.uz: Kasal yoki charchagan paytingizda hech qachon sho'ng'imang. Agar sho'ng'isangiz, xavfli vaziyatda o'zingizni qutqarish uchun yetarli kuchingiz bo'lmasligi mumkin.

points.en: Make sure you check your air supply regularly while you are underwater. If you don't, you could run out of air and drown.
points.uz: Suv ostida havo zaxirangizni muntazam tekshirib turing. Agar tekshirmasangiz, havongiz tugab, cho'kib ketishingiz mumkin.
points.noteUz: ⚠ 'run out of air' = havo tugab qolmoq.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the leaflet, then mark the statements as T (true) or F (false).
exercises.instructionUz: Varaqani o'qing, so'ng gaplarni T (to'g'ri) yoki F (noto'g'ri) deb belgilang.
exercises.explanationUz:
VARAQAGA QARAB:
  1 'Never dive alone' → F
  2 'Always mark ... with a flag' → T
  3 'Never panic' → F
  4 'If you don't check ... you
    might have problems' → F
  5 'Never dive when you are ill'
    (cold = kasal) → T
  6 'run out of air and drown' → F

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the prompts and make sentences with always or never, as in the example. SAFE SAILING: 1 check/weather forecast before going sailing - you/sail into/storm 2 tell somebody where you are going - you/get into trouble/nobody/know where you/be 3 take warm, waterproof clothing with you - it/get cold/you/freeze to death 4 go sailing without/lifejacket - you/fall into/water/drown 5 sail close to rocks - you/destroy/boat/hurt yourself/drown 6 sail near swimmers - you/hurt somebody. Example: Always check the weather forecast before going sailing. If you don't, you could sail into a storm.
exercises.instructionUz: Ko'rsatmalarga qarang va always yoki never bilan gaplar tuzing, namunadagidek. XAVFSIZ YELKANLI SUZISh: 1 check/weather forecast before going sailing - you/sail into/storm 2 tell somebody where you are going - you/get into trouble/nobody/know where you/be 3 take warm, waterproof clothing with you - it/get cold/you/freeze to death 4 go sailing without/lifejacket - you/fall into/water/drown 5 sail close to rocks - you/destroy/boat/hurt yourself/drown 6 sail near swimmers - you/hurt somebody. Namuna: Yelkanli suzishga chiqishdan oldin har doim ob-havo ma'lumotini tekshiring. Agar tekshirmasangiz, bo'ronga duch kelishingiz mumkin.
exercises.explanationUz:
XAVFSIZLIK QOIDALARI - ALWAYS /
  NEVER + NATIJA.

  IJOBIY (1, 2, 3) → ALWAYS ... If
    you DON'T, you could/might ...
  SALBIY (4, 5, 6) → NEVER ... If
    you DO, you could/might ...


⚠ 'THE WEATHER FORECAST':

  = ob-havo ma'lumoti.


⚠ 'TO GET INTO TROUBLE':

  = muammoga duch kelmoq.


⚠ 'WATERPROOF CLOTHING':

  = suv o'tkazmaydigan kiyim.


⚠ 'TO FREEZE TO DEATH':

  = sovuqdan o'lmoq.


⚠ 'A LIFEJACKET':

  = qutqaruv jileti.


⚠ 'TO SAIL':

  = yelkanli qayiqda suzmoq.
exercises.exampleEn: Always check the weather forecast before going sailing. If you don't, you could sail into a storm.
exercises.exampleUz: Yelkanli suzishga chiqishdan oldin har doim ob-havo ma'lumotini tekshiring. Agar tekshirmasangiz, bo'ronga duch kelishingiz mumkin.
modelAnswers: Always tell somebody where you are going. If you don't, you might get into trouble and nobody will know where you are.
Always take warm, waterproof clothing with you. If you don't, it might get cold and you could freeze to death.
Never go sailing without a lifejacket. If you do, you could fall into the water and drown.
Never sail close to rocks. If you do, you could destroy your boat, hurt yourself or drown.
Never sail near swimmers. If you do, you might hurt somebody.
modelAnswersUz: Qayerga borayotganingizni har doim birovga ayting. Agar aytmasangiz, muammoga duch kelishingiz mumkin va hech kim qayerdaligingizni bilmaydi.
Har doim issiq, suv o'tkazmaydigan kiyim oling. Agar olmasangiz, sovuq bo'lishi va siz sovuqdan o'lishingiz mumkin.
Hech qachon qutqaruv jiletisiz suzishga chiqmang. Agar chiqsangiz, suvga tushib, cho'kib ketishingiz mumkin.
Hech qachon qoyalarga yaqin suzmang. Agar suzsangiz, qayig'ingizni buzishingiz, o'zingizni shikastlashingiz yoki cho'kib ketishingiz mumkin.
Hech qachon suzuvchilar yonida suzmang. Agar suzsangiz, birovni shikastlashingiz mumkin.

patterns.formula: Always + FE'L ... If you don't, you could/might + NATIJA.
patterns.exampleEn: Always check the weather forecast. If you don't, you could sail into a storm.
patterns.exampleUz: Har doim ob-havo ma'lumotini tekshiring. Aks holda bo'ronga duch kelishingiz mumkin.

patterns.exampleEn: I have to go to the bank. - So do I, but I don't have to go shopping. - Neither do I.
